descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92594 AC 3 · “Collapsed rows show accurate labeling and line count”.

Decision D6 · S1 · Daniela

Transcript / retention windows differ from UAT 3.6 in ways no ticket AC settles: archive 48 h (not 36), 'Earlier sessions' and 'Most Recent' are undated, Quick Dictation boxes never expire, windows are hard-coded (make them configurable?); the Nursing Home course card shows the last 3 visits (UAT 3.6 says 2) (Q5)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-16/S23, OAT-04/S19, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10, TC-11/S07

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S27 Yesterday's recording with no write today: its row says which day it is

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U2 The physician can open Prior Encounter Transcripts for a patient, and the prior encounters are listed there automatically. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 2; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given {hospitalPatient} with a 2-line bedside transcript dated yesterday ('QA16-LBL-Y1', 'QA16-LBL-Y2'), no write today and no history

When Open the Encounter tab and look at Prior Encounter Transcripts without opening anything; then open the row

Then The recording is listed, and its label says it is yesterday's (its date), not an undated 'Most Recent'

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92594 AC 3 'accurate labeling' (T2). cp1 (collapsed): mustContain {hospitalPatient}, 'Prior Encounter Transcripts', '2 lines'; the row label is recorded (spec.manual). Judged once Q5 is settled: Pass only if the label carries yesterday's date ('afterQ5' check: '{Mon D, yesterday}'); until then an undated 'Most Recent' is reported as 'Q5 pending', not Pass. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment dev · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa
